load_bsuite_environment_from_id: load a bsuite environment by its bsuite_id like catch/0 using load_from_id
load_bsuite_environment_by_name: load a bsuite environment by experiment name and kwargs using the load function
load_and_record_to_csv: load a bsuite environment and record results to CSV files in a directory
load_and_record_to_terminal: load a bsuite environment and log results directly to the terminal
unpack_bsuite_id: unpack a bsuite_id string into its experiment name and setting index tuple
